The vaulted ceiling is lost in shadow, but faint outlines of arched windows can be seen high up, their glass obscured by grime and cobwebs. The implied depth is immense, drawing the eye upwards and into the unseen upper levels of the mansion.

The composition is highly asymmetric. The grand staircase and archway create a diagonal thrust, leading the eye from lower right to upper left. The foreground steps on the left add a counterpoint. The scale is emphasized by the sheer height of the walls and the receding architectural features.
